COPY THIS STRUCTURE [Shortcut] for [subject]. Use [references]. Keep [fixed details]. Change [specific elements]. Style: [look, light, colors]. Include this exact text: [words]. Format: [shape / dimensions]. THREE CONNECTED WORKFLOWS Product launch /productshot > /colorways > /staticad > /productreel Approve the product details first. Reuse that reference at every later stage. Personal brand /headshot > /linkedinbanner > /quotecard Keep the palette and portrait style consistent across the whole set. Explain an idea /processdiagram > /slidevisual > /explainerclip Verify the facts and wording before adapting the concept into motion. IMAGES, VIDEO & CONNECTED TOOLS In ChatGPT, describe a new image or attach an image and explain the edit. For video, also give the action, camera movement, duration, framing and audio needs. Supported settings depend on the tool you use. For Higgsfield, follow the official connection page, add its plugin, then sign in and authorize. Its current documentation requires an active subscription; generations use account credits. Use its reference-upload flow when needed. Check the available options before generating. Use generated work as a draft: proofread text and check product accuracy, dimensions and required formats. Technical drawings, floor plans, logo concepts and packaging mockups still need production review.
